lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਪੀਵੈ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo peevai so tripataavai ||
lines.translation: Whoever drinks this in, is satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: amar hovai jo naam ras paavai ||
lines.translation: Whoever obtains the Sublime Essence of the Naam becomes immortal.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan tisahi paraapat jis sabad guroo man voothaa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: The Treasure of the Naam is obtained by one whose mind is filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin har ras paaiaa so tripat aghaanaa ||
lines.translation: One who obtains the Sublime Essence of the Lord is satisfied and fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਨਾਹਿ ਡੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin har saad paaiaa so naahi dulaanaa ||
lines.translation: One who obtains this Flavor of the Lord does not waver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tisahi paraapat har har naamaa jis masatak bhaageethaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: One who has this destiny written on his forehead obtains the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਆਇਆ ਵਰਸਾਣੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ikas hath aaiaa varasaane bahutere ||
lines.translation: The Lord has come into the hands of the One, the Guru, who has blessed so many with good fortune.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਘਣੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis lag mukat bhae ghanere ||
lines.translation: Attached to Him, a great many have been liberated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਡੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaanaa guramukh paaeeai kahu naanak viralee deethaa jeeu ||4||15||22||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the Treasure of the Naam; says Nanak, those who see the Lord are very rare. ||4||15||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nidh sidh ridh har har har merai ||
lines.translation: My Lord, Har, Har, Har, is the nine treasures, the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, wealth and prosperity.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath gahir ga(n)bheerai ||
lines.translation: He is the Deep and Profound Treasure of Life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: laakh kot khuseeaa ra(n)g raavai jo gur laagaa paaee jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Hundreds of thousands, even millions of pleasures and delights are enjoyed by one who falls at the Guru's Feet. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan pekhat bhae puneetaa ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are sanctified,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal udhaare bhaaee meetaa ||
lines.translation: and all family and friends are saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar suaamee apunaa gur kirapaa te sach dhiaaee jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Inaccessible and Unfathomable True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau khojahi sarab upaae ||
lines.translation: The One, the Guru, who is sought by all-only a few,

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee darasan ko viralaa paae ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, receive His Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਥਾਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇਖਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ooch apaar agochar thaanaa ohu mahal guroo dekhaaee jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: His Place is lofty, infinite and unfathomable; the Guru has shown me that palace. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gahir ga(n)bheer a(n)mrit naam teraa ||
lines.translation: Your Ambrosial Name is deep and profound.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukat bhaiaa jis ridai vaseraa ||
lines.translation: That person is liberated, in whose heart You dwell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur ba(n)dhan tin ke sagale kaate jan naanak sahaj samaaee jeeu ||4||16||23||
lines.translation: The Guru cuts away all his bonds; O Servant Nanak, he is absorbed in the poise of intuitive peace. ||4||16||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh kirapaa te har har dhiaavau ||
lines.translation: By God's Grace, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhoo daiaa te ma(n)gal gaavau ||
lines.translation: By God's Kindness, I sing the songs of joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਗਲ ਅਵਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: oothat baithat sovat jaagat har dhiaaeeai sagal avaradaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: While standing and sitting, while sleeping and while awake, meditate on the Lord, all your life. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam aukhadh mo kau saadhoo deeaa ||
lines.translation: The Holy Saint has given me the Medicine of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kilabikh kaate niramal theeaa ||
lines.translation: My sins have been cut out, and I have become pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਸਭ ਪੀਰਾ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਦਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: anad bhaiaa nikasee sabh peeraa sagal binaase daradaa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: I am filled with bliss, and all my pains have been taken away. All my suffering has been dispelled. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kaa a(n)g kare meraa piaaraa ||
lines.translation: One who has my Beloved on his side,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: so mukataa saagar sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: Is liberated from the world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਡਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sat kare jin guroo pachhaataa so kaahe kau daradaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: One who recognizes the Guru practices Truth; why should he be afraid? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab te saadhoo sa(n)gat paae ||
lines.translation: Since I found the Company of the Holy and met the Guru,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਉ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bhetat hau gaee balaae ||
lines.translation: The demon of pride has departed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਢਾਕਿ ਲੀਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੜਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas har gaavai naanak satigur dhaak leeaa meraa paRadaa jeeu ||4||17||24||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, Nanak sings the Lord's Praises. The True Guru has covered my sins. ||4||17||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ot pot sevak sa(n)g raataa ||
lines.translation: Through and through, the Lord is intermingled with His servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh pratipaale sevak sukhadaataa ||
lines.translation: God, the Giver of Peace, cherishes His servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਆਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paanee pakhaa peesau sevak kai thaakur hee kaa aahar jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: I carry the water, wave the fan, and grind the grain for the servant of my Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaat silak prabh sevaa laaiaa ||
lines.translation: God has cut the noose from around my neck; He has placed me in His Service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam saahib kaa sevak man bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord and Master's Command is pleasing to the mind of His servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: soee kamaavai jo saahib bhaavai sevak a(n)tar baahar maahar jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: He does that which pleases his Lord and Master. Inwardly and outwardly, the servant knows his Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) daanaa thaakur sabh bidh jaanahi ||
lines.translation: You are the All-knowing Lord and Master; You know all ways and means.
